30421-the-age-of-pope-1700-1744.title: The Age Of Pope 1700 1744
30421-the-age-of-pope-1700-1744.creator: Unknown
30421-the-age-of-pope-1700-1744.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ed by Professor Hales, which it is hoped will be of service to students who love literature for its own sake, instead of regarding it merely as a branch of knowledge required by examiners. The period covered by this volume, which has had the great advantage of Professor Hales's personal care and revision, may be described roughly as lying between 1700, the year in which Dryden died, and 1744, the date of Pope's death.

arxiv-2101-07631.title: Improved Coefficients for the Karagiannidis–Lioumpas Approximations and Bounds to the Gaussian Q Q -Function
arxiv-2101-07631.creator: Islam M. Tanash, Taneli Riihonen
arxiv-2101-07631.description: Abstract We revisit the Karagiannidis–Lioumpas (KL) approximation of the Q Q -function by optimizing its coefficients in terms of absolute error, relative error and total error. For minimizing the maximum absolute/relative error, we describe the targeted uniform error functions by sets of nonlinear equations so that the optimized coefficients are the solutions thereof.

arxiv-2110-11964.title: Molecular Chemistry for Dark Matter II: Recombination, Molecule Formation, and Halo Mass Function in Atomic Dark Matter Recfast++ ( Chluba et al. 2010 ) , Julia ( Bezanson et al. 2012 ) , DifferentialEquations library ( Rackauckas & Nie 2017 )
arxiv-2110-11964.creator: James Gurian, Donghui Jeong, Michael Ryan, Sarah Shandera
arxiv-2110-11964.description: Abstract Dissipative dark matter predicts rich observable phenomena that can be tested with future large-scale structure surveys. As a specific example, we study atomic dark matter, consisting of a heavy particle and a light particle charged under a dark electromagnetism. In particular, we calculate the cosmological evolution of atomic dark matter focusing on dark recombination and dark-molecule formation.

arxiv-2301-13225.title: An infinite family of w 1 + ∞ w_{1+\infty} invariant theories on the celestial sphere
arxiv-2301-13225.creator: Shamik Banerjee, Harshal Kulkarni, Partha Paul
arxiv-2301-13225.description: Abstract In this note we determine the graviton-graviton OPE and the null states in any w 1 + ∞ w_{1+\infty} symmetric theory on the celestial sphere. Our analysis shows that there exists a discrete infinite family of such theories. The MHV-sector and the quantum self dual gravity are two members of this infinite family.

arxiv-2302-04907.title: Binarized Neural Machine Translation
arxiv-2302-04907.creator: Yichi Zhang, Ankush Garg, Yuan Cao, Łukasz Lew, Behrooz Ghorbani, Zhiru Zhang, Orhan Firat
arxiv-2302-04907.description: Abstract The rapid scaling of language models is motivating research using low-bitwidth quantization. In this work, we propose a novel binarization technique for Transformers applied to machine translation (BMT), the first of its kind. We identify and address the problem of inflated dot-product variance when using one-bit weights and activations.

arxiv-2311-14946.title: RFSoC-based front-end electronics for pulse detection
arxiv-2311-14946.creator: L. A. Winslow
arxiv-2311-14946.description: Abstract Radiation measurement relies on pulse detection, which can be performed using various configurations of high-speed analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) and field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). For optimal power consumption, design simplicity, system flexibility, and the availability of DSP slices, we consider the Radio Frequency System-on-Chip (RFSoC) to be a more suitable option than traditional setups.

arxiv-2402-04416.title: Multimodal Unsupervised Domain Generalization by Retrieving Across the Modality Gap
arxiv-2402-04416.creator: Christopher Liao, Christian So, Theodoros Tsiligkaridis, Brian Kulis
arxiv-2402-04416.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Christopher Liao, Christian So, Theodoros Tsiligkaridis, Brian Kulis. Domain generalization (DG) is an important problem that learns a model which generalizes to unseen test domains leveraging one or more source domains, under the assumption of shared label spaces. However, most DG methods assume access to abundant source data in the target label space, a requirement that proves overly stringent for numerous real-world applications, where acquiring the same label space as the target task is prohibitively expensive.

arxiv-2411-15094.title: Thermalization effects on the dynamics of growing vacuum bubbles
arxiv-2411-15094.creator: Tomasz Krajewski, Marek Lewicki, Martin Vasar, Ville Vaskonen, Hardi Veermäe, and Mateusz Zych
arxiv-2411-15094.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tomasz Krajewski, Marek Lewicki, Martin Vasar, Ville Vaskonen, Hardi Veermäe, and Mateusz Zych. We study the evolution of growing vacuum bubbles. The bubble walls interact with the surrounding fluid and may, consequently, reach a terminal velocity. If the mean free path of the particles in the fluid is much shorter than the bubble wall thickness, the fluid is locally in thermal equilibrium and the wall’s terminal velocity can be determined by entropy conservation.

arxiv-2411-16561.title: EnStack: An Ensemble Stacking Framework of Large Language Models for Enhanced Vulnerability Detection in Source Code
arxiv-2411-16561.creator: Shahriyar Zaman Ridoy, Md. Shazzad Hossain Shaon, Alfredo Cuzzocrea, Mst Shapna Akter
arxiv-2411-16561.description: Abstract Automated detection of software vulnerabilities is critical for enhancing security, yet existing methods often strug- gle with the complexity and diversity of modern codebases. In this paper, we introduce EnStack, a novel ensemble stacking framework that enhances vulnerability detection using natural language processing (NLP) techniques.

arxiv-2502-14298.title: Generalization Certificates for Adversarially Robust Bayesian Linear Regression
arxiv-2502-14298.creator: Mahalakshmi Sabanayagam, Russell Tsuchida, Cheng Soon Ong, Debarghya Ghoshdastidar
arxiv-2502-14298.description: Abstract Adversarial robustness of machine learning models is critical to ensuring reliable performance under data perturbations. Recent progress has been on point estimators, and this paper considers distributional predictors. First, using the link between exponential families and Bregman divergences, we formulate an adversarial Bregman divergence loss as an adversarial negative log-likelihood.

arxiv-2511-02972.title: Lemma on logarithmic derivative over directed manifolds
arxiv-2511-02972.creator: Peiqiang Lin
arxiv-2511-02972.description: Abstract . In this paper, we generalize Ahlfors’ lemma on logarithmic derivative to holomorphic tangent curves of directed projective manifolds intersecting closed subschemes. As a consequence, we obtain Algebro-Geometric Ahlfors’ Lemma on Logarithmic Derivative (AALD for short) and General form of Algebro-Geometric Version of Ahlfors’ Lemma on Logarithmic Derivative (GAALD for short) for holomorphic tangent curves of directed projective manifolds.

pmc-11478962.title: Fluctuations in Mediterranean Diet Adherence Pre- and Post-Pandemic: A Study of Portuguese Cohorts 2019–2024
pmc-11478962.creator: Vanda Lopes de Andrade, Paula Pinto, Jean L Fry
pmc-11478962.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objectives: The Mediterranean Diet (MD) is a lifestyle offering numerous health benefits. Nevertheless, the adherence to the MD is moderate even in Mediterranean countries. While sociodemographic factors influence MD adherence, additional impacts occurred due to the COVID-19 pandemic. This cross-sectional longitudinal study with three cohorts of Portuguese adults analyzes MD adherence before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic, and explores the effect of sociodemographic variables.

pmc-11485009.title: Treatment-resistant depression: molecular mechanisms and management
pmc-11485009.creator: Mayanja M Kajumba, Angelina Kakooza-Mwesige, Noeline Nakasujja, Deborah Koltai, Turhan Canli
pmc-11485009.description: Due to the heterogeneous nature of depression, the underlying etiological mechanisms greatly differ among individuals, and there are no known subtype-specific biomarkers to serve as precise targets for therapeutic efficacy. The extensive research efforts over the past decades have not yielded much success, and the currently used first-line conventional antidepressants are still ineffective for close to 66% of patients.

pmc-12581236.title: Children with recurrent urinary tract infections: who are they and why do we need better prevention options?
pmc-12581236.creator: Virginie Boulanger, Hubert Vincent, Zineb Laghdir, Diego Barrieras, Julie Franc-Guimond, Elyse Potvin, Caroline Quach
pmc-12581236.description: BackgroundRecurrent UTIs (rUTIs) in children can lead to renal scarring and chronic renal failure, if not managed early. There is a need for new interventions, other than antimicrobial use, to reduce the occurrence of rUTIs as well as the identification of groups to target.

Methods: A cross-sectional analysis integrated clinical registry data with representative, online school-recruited adolescents (11 to 17) self-reports.

pmc-12804184.title: Phylodynamic analysis reveals disparate transmission dynamics of Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex lineages in Botswana
pmc-12804184.creator: Qiao Wang, Ivan Barilar, Volodymyr M Minin, Chawangwa Modongo, Patrick K Moonan, Alyssa Finlay, Rosanna Boyd, John E Oeltmann, Tuduetso L Molefi, Nicola M Zetola, Timothy F Brewer, Stefan Niemann, Sanghyuk S Shin
pmc-12804184.description: Tuberculosis epidemics have traditionally been conceptualized as arising from a single uniform pathogen. However, Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex (Mtbc), the pathogen causing tuberculosis in humans, encompasses multiple lineages exhibiting genetic and phenotypic diversity that may be responsible for heterogeneity in tuberculosis transmission.
